# Avento Drones

> Professional CAA Certified UAV Drone Photography & 4K Aerial Cinematography in the UK.

## Overview
Avento Drones is a premier UK drone operations service providing high-definition aerial photography, 4K cinematography, architectural mapping, and commercial site surveys. 

- Website: https://aventodrones.co.uk
- Contact Email: William@aventodrones.co.uk
- Operating Region: United Kingdom (Manchester, North West England, Cheshire, Lancashire & Nationwide)
- Copyright: © 2026 Avento Drones. All Rights Reserved.

## Services & Packages
1. **Aerial Photography** (From £100)
   - High-resolution RAW aerial stills
   - Professional color correction & post-processing
   - Ideal for real estate, roof inspections, and architectural portfolios
   - 48-hour digital delivery

2. **4K Aerial Cinematography** (From £150 - Most Popular)
   - Ultra-stabilized 4K aerial video capture
   - Advanced color grading & cinematic tuning
   - Commercial imagery stills package included

3. **Custom Branded Media Package** (From £200)
   - Narrative commercial aerial video editing
   - Brand logo integration & licensed soundtrack
   - Multi-format exports (16:9 desktop, 9:16 social media)

## Qualifications & Safety Standards
- **CAA Certification**: Operating legally under CAA GVC & A2 CoC remote pilot qualifications.
- **Insurance Cover**: £1,000,000 (£1M) Public Liability Insurance policy (FPV UK).
- **Safety Standard**: Pre-flight airspace risk assessments and weather verification conducted for every mission.

## Key Projects & Portfolio
- Industrial Manufacturing Site (Aerial survey & roof inspection)
- Private Residential Property (Cinematography & boundary showcase)
- Commercial Production Facility (4K marketing media package)
- Educational & Public Sector Facility (High-altitude site mapping)
